name: Nike 2nd Barcelona Kobe Bryant Mamba Woven

description.subtitle: FC Barcelona Nike sweatshirt x Kobe Bryant - black
description.tagline: Estilo FCB x Mamba dentro y fuera del campo
description.intro: The Nike 2nd Barcelona Kobe Bryant Mamba Woven jacket blends FC Barcelona's identity with Kobe Bryant's legacy into a garment designed to offer comfort, protection and an exclusive style. Its black design with details from the Mamba collection reflects the competitive mindset that unites two sports icons.
key_benefits: Lightweight Woven Fabric: Provides comfort and protection without giving up mobility.
Loose adjustment: Promotes total freedom of movement.
Acabado repelente al agua: Protege frente a la lluvia ligera y la humedad.
FC Barcelona Design: Print inspired by Kobe Bryant's legacy and the Blaugrana identity.
